evidence.s1: Environment table (part two) keeps source/declared/drawn statistics separate across 8 scheme×phase rows; drawn window/module bodies stay outside the dead band at light 0.635–0.872 and dark 0.164–0.324.
evidence.s2: Three named surfaces at rest in shot-fv-light.png: Now, Places, Today — not the six-tile field the brief listed.
evidence.s3: Record's built sizes: Now ~320×332, Places ~496×404, Today ~376×600, all with shorter span well above 96; family thickness 8 is named across every surface.
evidence.s4: shot-fv-light.png/dark.png show the sky band above the search field, gaps between the three columns, and the valley's foreground band below every window, all painted environment.
evidence.s5: Record: 'No clear variant anywhere' — every capture (phase-1 through phase-4, both schemes) shows the same regular frosted material.
evidence.s6: No clear glass is used on this page (record), so the clear-glass-over-media constraint is not engaged.
evidence.s7: Record: 'tint: none... Accent withheld, deliberately' — no capture shows a tinted control.
evidence.s8: The five runtime GlassSurface groups (Now/Places/Today/Search/Photograph) are the only glass; record's diagnostics report zero authoring findings across 32 configurations, with no hand-rolled blur or opaque fill substituted for the material.
evidence.s9: Record's family section: windows/module fixed radius 32, ornaments capsules (56→28, 48→24), platter fixed 24 — no other radius kind is named.
evidence.s10: Record: inner fills inset 20 take 32−20=12, rows inset 12 take 12−4=8, the search mark inset 8 takes 28−8=20, photo frames take 24−12=12 — every nested radius is derived from its parent's.
evidence.s11: The Search and Photograph ornaments (floating layer, shot-fv-light.png) are capsules; the Places grid's twelve tiles (dense desktop controls) are rounded rectangles, not capsules.
evidence.s12: Search is one glass group (glyph + field) and Photograph is a separate one-member group (record: 'groups: five, one member each'); no bar combines unrelated items or exceeds three groups.
evidence.s13: Photograph's closed capsule ('Dusk Marco Usan ⌄', shot-fv-light.png) is a single button carrying its own icon+text label, and Search is a glyph plus one text field — no capture shows a text button sharing a background with a separate icon button.
evidence.s14: Record: five one-member groups with material on the host (GlassSurface) itself; children (tiles, rows, checkboxes) are plain content per the record's architecture.
evidence.s15: Gaps are derived (record: 'measured 63.2 px... 71.6 / 76.6 under Reduce Transparency') specifically to keep Now/Places/Today reading as three separate materials, visible as the dark valley strip between columns in shot-fv-light.png.
evidence.s16: Record: the Today scroller has 'masked edge bands (28 px top, 36 px bottom)' that fade lines passing under them; scroller-1-middle-light.png shows the top agenda row rendered faint against the sharp rows below it.
evidence.s17: Record item 0 fixed the dawn crop specifically because the search ornament first sat over 'a flat gradient'; all four phase captures show the search and window footprints over cloud, ridge, fields or stars, never a flat sky.
evidence.s18: Contrast matrix (record): 13,656 gated readings (9,536 text + 2,240 large + 1,880 marks), 0 below floor, worst 4.81–4.93:1, across both schemes and tiers.
evidence.s19: Record: Reduce Transparency (shot-reduced.png) and Reduce Motion (GlassMorph fix-wave, read live across dozens of frames) both hold; Increase Contrast is included in the 32-configuration zero-diagnostic sweep and is explicitly 'looked at' in the contrast section.
evidence.s20: Record's fix-wave item 8: the forced-colours CanvasText frame is drawn on each host's child, 'Never on the host'; no background/border/scrim is authored on any of the five hosts, and the dark evening-print curve is environment grading (s1), not an added scrim.
evidence.s21: The Photograph platter is a GlassMorph that opens from its own ornament (record fix-wave finding 1, read live across dozens of frames) rather than cross-fading; the switch knob's only owned motion is a 180 ms slide removed under Reduce Motion.
evidence.s22: Record: 'tint: none'; weather and task icons render as monochrome black/white glyphs in every capture (e.g. shot-fv-light.png), with saturated colour appearing only in the photograph.
evidence.s23: Ink tokens are fixed per-scheme greys rather than colour-matched; no capture shows a label blending into the sunset or cypress-road hues behind it.
evidence.s24: Record item 7 removed the module's one-sentence outlook because prose doesn't belong in a glance module, leaving Now as figures only (shot-fv-light.png); item 1's authored secondary ink holds the ratio on every description line, worst line gated per the contrast matrix.
evidence.s25: Record item 2: the event-in-progress row takes a light 7%/13% white lift (interactive/selected) while Places tiles sit on their own lighter child fills; no nested glass host is named anywhere.
evidence.s26: Search and Photograph are separate overlay-plane groups attached above Places and below Now respectively, 'no wider than it,' held out by the derived gap (record); the platter was deliberately routed to open into open environment rather than over a window.
evidence.s27: Record: platter photograph thumbnails 'sit in frames of 24−12=12' (opaque, concentric); the Now module carries no oversized image, only icons and figures.
evidence.s28: No accent colour exists on the page (tint: none); the one emphasis device — the lighter selected fill — covers an entire tile/row rather than a thin mark, per record and shot-fv-light.png.
evidence.s29: Record: 'tint: none... a tinted primary would be a second hue fighting a sunset' — identity is carried by the four valley photographs alone.
evidence.s30: Record's fix-wave table gives cssBody at every viewport/DPR (collapsed at 1440×900, two-layer at 1024×768) with css-fv.png/css-menu.png showing the CSS tier; shot-forced.png shows Canvas panels with a CanvasText frame and readable marks; the fidelity section states window spans '320–500 extrapolate the fitted laws beyond the span-160 bed' and 'No clear variant anywhere,' leaving nothing uncalibrated-but-unstated.
